summary: Short, steep kerb by a bus stop at Five Ways; No Stopping.

best_section.where: South kerb at the Five Ways junction, beside the bus stop

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 7 m away at the end; shopping centre car park opposite; fully exposed.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb at a junction mouth with a bus stop; little room clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Heavy: busy signalised junction and buses.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time; no one parks overnight here.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; some shrubs on the south side.
